description: Angular component for displaying and comparing different versions of an entity, including diff visualization and restore functionality.

classes.name: EntityVersionDiffComponent
classes.description: Angular component for visualizing differences between entity versions with diff navigation and restore options.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, fetches version diff data, and sets up the diff viewer.

methods.name: versionIdContent
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the version ID and name.

methods.name: moveToDiff
methods.description: Scrolls the diff viewer to the specified diff.

methods.name: onFullscreenChanged
methods.description: Handles toggling fullscreen mode and resizes editors accordingly.

methods.name: getCurrentRow
methods.description: Gets the current cursor position in the diff view.

methods.name: nextDiff
methods.description: Finds the next diff after the current position.

methods.name: prevDiff
methods.description: Finds the previous diff before the current position.

methods.name: updateHasNextAndPrevious
methods.description: Updates navigation button states based on current position.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: toggleRestoreEntityVersion
methods.description: Displays a popover to restore a specific entity version.
